# Frontier Orchestration

> An agent skill and plugin that routes high-stakes work across frontier models from different vendors.
> It runs in Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Antigravity, and any agent through skills.sh.
> For each task it asks the engine (Jev) which model fits, then gates the pick on confidence x stakes: act, ESCALATE or REJECT.
> The engine can be TypeSafe Jev, OpenJev, any compatible server, or off (local rules).
> Everything runs through one Python standard-library command line: skills/frontier-orchestration/scripts/fo.py.

Start with SKILL.md for the agent rules. Then run `fo.py --help` for the command list. All paths are relative to the repository root.

## Skill

- [SKILL.md](skills/frontier-orchestration/SKILL.md): the rules an agent follows: discovery, routing, the gate, the independence rule, pipelines, the learning loop
- [commands/setup.md](commands/setup.md): the Claude Code `/frontier-orchestration:setup` command

## Code

- [fo.py](skills/frontier-orchestration/scripts/fo.py): the command line: install, setup, doctor, providers, ask, route, eval, refresh, config, jev ping, lessons, telemetry; exit codes
- [fo_route.py](skills/frontier-orchestration/scripts/fo_route.py): routing: candidate filter, the two engine questions, the confidence x stakes gate, the local heuristic, the demo spec
- [fo_eval.py](skills/frontier-orchestration/scripts/fo_eval.py): `fo.py eval`: the sanity and routing suites, metrics, hard checks, exit codes
- [fo_install.py](skills/frontier-orchestration/scripts/fo_install.py): the interactive installer, OpenJev builds, the MLX launcher and the Docker path
- [fo_providers.py](skills/frontier-orchestration/scripts/fo_providers.py): how each vendor CLI is found, its sign-in check, and the read-only `fo.py ask` runner
- [fo_jev.py](skills/frontier-orchestration/scripts/fo_jev.py): the engine client: key lookup, HTTPS rule, error messages, ping
- [fo_config.py](skills/frontier-orchestration/scripts/fo_config.py): the config file, engine defaults, environment overrides
- [fo_refresh.py](skills/frontier-orchestration/scripts/fo_refresh.py): the model snapshot from each CLI and roster drift
- [fo_lessons.py](skills/frontier-orchestration/scripts/fo_lessons.py): the learning ledger (lessons and runs)
- [fo_telemetry.py](skills/frontier-orchestration/scripts/fo_telemetry.py): the opt-in telemetry allowlist and switches
- [roster.json](skills/frontier-orchestration/data/roster.json): model ids, vendors, tiers, aliases, descriptions
- [evals/](skills/frontier-orchestration/evals/): the sanity (24 questions) and routing (20 tasks) datasets

## References

- [references/providers.md](skills/frontier-orchestration/references/providers.md): transports, `fo.py ask` flags, notes per CLI, failure signs
- [references/pipeline.md](skills/frontier-orchestration/references/pipeline.md): the estimate pipeline and the code ship-gate loop

- [references/privacy.md](skills/frontier-orchestration/references/privacy.md): the privacy notice shipped inside the skill (a copy of PRIVACY.md)

## Tests and collector

- [tests/](tests/): the Python test suite; run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [tests/e2e/](tests/e2e/): the first-run smoke script (`smoke.sh`, which always runs `smoke_body.sh` under `supervise.py`), the installer driver and OpenJev build comparison scripts
- [scripts/prepublish_check.py](scripts/prepublish_check.py): the release gate: checks every commit of a history before it is published
- [collector/](collector/): the telemetry collector source (Vercel Functions, Postgres)
